spec.query:
from(bucket: "mikrotik")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "snmp_trap")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${Node}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "hookStatus1")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({"_time": r._time, "_value": r._value}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "futel")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "futel_event")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["endpoint"] == "seattle-thistle" or r["endpoint"] == "seattle-fortysecond" or r["endpoint"] == "seattle-estelitas" or r["endpoint"] == "seattle-cafered")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] == "outgoing-dialstatus-completed")
  |> group(columns: ["endpoint"])
  |> count(column: "_field")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    "Location": r.endpoint,
    "Count": r._field
  }))
  |> sort(columns: ["Count"], desc: true)

import "experimental/json"
import "strings"
from(bucket: "mikrotik")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${Node}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "shadytel_ifconfig_me")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "the_json")
  |> map(
    fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _field: r._field,
      ip_addr: if (strings.index(substr: "{", v:r._value,) != 0) then "∅" else json.parse(data: bytes(v: r._value)).ip_addr
    }))
  |> aggregateWindow(column: "ip_addr", every: 2m, fn: last)

from(bucket: "mikrotik")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "snmp-interfaces")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes-out" or r["_field"] == "bytes-in")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${Node}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["if-name"] == "wg-shdy")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(nonNegative: true, unit: 1s)

from(bucket: "mikrotik")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "snmp-interfaces")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes-out" or r["_field"] == "bytes-in")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${Node}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["if-name"] == "wg-shdy")
  |> derivative(nonNegative: true, unit: 1s)
  |> integral(unit: 1s)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 8.0 }))
